title: •Endor Celebration
caption: •Endor Celebration (V)
game_text: Cancel an Effect with “occupation” in title. {sense} OR During your draw phase, if you have a Rebel scout alone at Back Door, draw destiny. Activate or retrieve 5 Force and place this Interrupt on bottom of Lost Pile if destiny < the number of your scouts on table.
lore: The Rebel presence on Endor meant that the Ewoks would be able to live free from the Empire’s tyranny.
